name: neowiki_statement
comment: One row per Subject and property on a page, as of the revision the page publishes. Written with neowiki_subject. nwst_statement holds the Statement as JSON (propertyType and value); nwst_search_text holds what the Statement's Property Type says its value contributes to search, case-folded, or is null when it contributes nothing.

columns.name: nwst_page_id
columns.comment: Page whose subject slot holds the Subject

columns.name: nwst_property
columns.comment: Name of the Statement's property, cut to 255 bytes on a character boundary

columns.name: nwst_statement
columns.comment: The Statement as JSON: propertyType and value

columns.name: nwst_search_text
columns.comment: Case-folded search text of the Statement's value, null when the Property Type contributes none
